tools.name: get_service_info
tools.description:
Return service information: operator, supported markets with live catalog statistics, how prices are matched, and an overview of the available tools.

Use when you need to know which markets are supported or how the service
works before calling other tools.

findings.title: Description issues instructions to the model
findings.detail: Description of "get_service_info" contains imperative instructions directed at the AI assistant rather than describing the tool. This is the core tool-poisoning technique.

evidence.snippet: Return service information: operator, supported markets with live catalog statistics, how prices are matched, and an overview of the available tools. Use when y…

findings.remediation: Treat the server as untrusted; the model may obey embedded instructions.
